named_timing_parameters.tCK: Clock period (1/data_rate × 2 = 2.5 ns at DDR3-800, 1.875 ns at DDR3-1066, 1.5 ns at DDR3-1333, 1.25 ns at DDR3-1600).
named_timing_parameters.tRCD: ACTIVATE-to-internal-RD-or-WR delay (row-to-column delay); typical 13.75 ns at DDR3-1600.
named_timing_parameters.tRP: PRECHARGE command period (row precharge time); typical 13.75 ns at DDR3-1600.
named_timing_parameters.tRAS: ACTIVATE-to-PRECHARGE delay (active to precharge); minimum 35-37.5 ns; maximum 9 × tREFI.
named_timing_parameters.tRC: ACTIVATE-to-ACTIVATE delay (same bank); tRC = tRAS + tRP; ~48.75-50 ns.
named_timing_parameters.tFAW: Four-Activate-Window: four ACT commands within this window maximum; 25-50 ns depending on speed grade & page size.
named_timing_parameters.tRRD: ACTIVATE-to-ACTIVATE delay between different banks; min 4-7.5 ns or 4 nCK whichever larger.
named_timing_parameters.tWR: Write recovery time (last DQ-in to PRECHARGE); 15 ns (programmed into MR0 in clock cycles via WR field).
named_timing_parameters.tWTR: Write-to-Read delay (last write data to read command); max(4 nCK, 7.5 ns).
named_timing_parameters.tRTP: Internal Read-to-Precharge command delay; max(4 nCK, 7.5 ns).
named_timing_parameters.tCCD: Column-to-Column delay; 4 nCK fixed for DDR3 (consequence of 8n prefetch).
named_timing_parameters.tRFC: Refresh cycle time; depends on density: 90 ns (512 Mb), 110 ns (1 Gb), 160 ns (2 Gb), 260 ns (4 Gb), 350 ns (8 Gb).
named_timing_parameters.tREFI: Average refresh interval; 7.8 µs at normal temp (0–85 °C), 3.9 µs at extended temp (0–95 °C with SRT/double-refresh).
named_timing_parameters.tDQSCK: Strobe to clock skew on read; typically −400 ps to +400 ps in DLL-on mode.
named_timing_parameters.tDQSQ: DQS to DQ skew within a byte lane; ≤ 100-200 ps typical.
named_timing_parameters.tQH: DQ output hold from DQS; ≥ tCH/2 nominal.
named_timing_parameters.tDS: Data setup time to DQS edge (write); ~25-75 ps + slew-rate derating.
named_timing_parameters.tDH: Data hold time after DQS edge (write); ~75-150 ps + slew-rate derating.
named_timing_parameters.tIS: Address/Command setup time to CK edge; ~125-200 ps + slew-rate derating.
named_timing_parameters.tIH: Address/Command hold time after CK edge; ~200 ps + slew-rate derating.
named_timing_parameters.tMOD: MRS-to-non-MRS minimum delay; max(12 nCK, 15 ns).
named_timing_parameters.tDLLK: DLL locking time after DLL reset / Self-Refresh exit; 512 nCK.
named_timing_parameters.tZQinit: First ZQCL after reset; min 512 nCK.
named_timing_parameters.tCKSRE: Valid clock requirement after Self-Refresh entry; min 10 ns or 5 nCK whichever larger.
named_timing_parameters.tCKSRX: Valid clock requirement before Self-Refresh exit; min 10 ns or 5 nCK.
named_timing_parameters.tXS: Self-Refresh exit to any command not requiring DLL.
named_timing_parameters.tXSDLL: Self-Refresh exit to command requiring DLL.
named_timing_parameters.tXPR: Reset-to-first-MRS delay after CKE rising; max(tXS, 5 nCK).
named_timing_parameters.tCKE: CKE minimum HIGH or LOW pulse width.
named_timing_parameters.tCKESR: Minimum CKE LOW pulse width during Self-Refresh.

clock_constants.note: data rate (MT/s) = 2 / tCK(ns) x 1000 (double data rate).

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.MRS_RAS_L_CAS_L_WE_L: MRS code: CS#=L, RAS#=L, CAS#=L, WE#=L
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.SRE_REF_with_CKE_L: Self-Refresh Entry has same RAS/CAS/WE as REF but CKE LOW
